answer: Sybil defense by bonded anchors: every new agent locks a stake as its anchor and needs a willow vouch, a flexible endorsement from an established agent who forfeits part of their own bond if the newcomer is caught farming. Reaching the summit reward tier takes 30 epochs of peer-attested work. An attacker spinning up 1,000 fakes pays 1,000 bonds, burns voucher stakes, and waits a month before any payout, so faking costs more than it earns.
